I recently checked out the drawing class, and I’m so glad I did! The space is super welcoming, bright, and cozy—perfect for getting into the creative zone. The instructor,  is fantastic! They break things down really well and make learning fun, no matter your skill level. Whether you’re just starting or want to level up your drawing, they’ve got you covered.

featured_reviews.name: Ajit More
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of attending a session at drawing class, and I must say—it’s a welcome addition to the local art scene.

From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was warm, inviting, and creatively charged. The space is thoughtfully set up, with plenty of natural light, quality materials provided, and an inspiring display of student and instructor work that sets the tone.

The instructor, is not only technically skilled but also incredibly approachable. Whether you're a complete beginner or someone looking to refine your technique, they adapt their teaching style to each student’s level. What stands out is their ability to break down complex concepts—like perspective, shading, or figure drawing—into digestible, engaging lessons.

The class structure strikes a great balance between guided instruction and free exploration, encouraging creativity while building a solid foundation in drawing fundamentals. Class sizes are small, ensuring personalized attention and a supportive group dynamic.

This class is perfect for anyone looking to start or restart their artistic journey. With its combination of professional guidance, friendly environment, and clear passion for art education, it’s easy to see this drawing class becoming a local favorite.
